delivery.outcome: Ticket branches are temporary review isolation and repositories return to only their default branch when no pull request is open
nonGoals: No deletion of unmerged branches without an explicit owner decision
No replacement of pull requests with direct pushes
No LLM-based lifecycle or merge decision

architecture.decision: Specify branch cleanup as the terminal phase of the existing one-ticket one-PR lifecycle and preserve unmerged work unless its owner explicitly discards it
dataChanges: The governance contract gains an explicit terminal branch-cleanup state
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-017 while retaining existing branch isolation and protected pull-request rules

validation.evidence: Lifecycle markers are required across policy, source instructions and the managed adoption template
Existing governance and immutable adoption behavior remains green
